description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Salesforce Experience Cloud Web Developer based in the United States. 

 We are seeking a skilled Salesforce Experience Cloud Web Developer to build, enhance, and maintain engaging public-facing and authenticated web experiences on an enterprise Salesforce platform. In this role, you will contribute to a major public website redesign, combining modern front-end development expertise with UI and UX design capabilities. You will create responsive, accessible, and user-friendly interfaces while ensuring consistency across digital platforms. Working closely with stakeholders and content teams, you will transform business requirements into effective web solutions and intuitive user experiences. You will also play an important role in maintaining website performance, accessibility, and security standards. This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to contribute to impactful digital transformation initiatives within a collaborative Agile environment.

Accountabilities
 

 Build, develop, and maintain public-facing and authenticated websites using Salesforce Experience Cloud.

 Develop responsive and accessible front-end components using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Lightning Web Components (LWC).

 Contribute to the redesign of a large public-facing website, including page templates, navigation structures, content organization, and migration of existing content.

 Create wireframes, visual mockups, and interactive prototypes for new pages and components, presenting design concepts to stakeholders for feedback and approval before development.

 Apply consistent visual design and user interaction patterns across websites using the Salesforce Lightning Design System.

 Ensure all web experiences comply with Section 508 accessibility requirements and Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG), identifying and resolving accessibility issues.

 Collaborate with content owners and relevant stakeholders to publish website updates accurately and within established timelines.

 Monitor website performance, identify broken links, assess search visibility, and implement corrective improvements.

 Estimate development tasks in hours, track time against assigned Jira tickets, and maintain accurate technical documentation in Confluence.

 Apply applicable federal security hardening standards and best practices throughout website development and maintenance.

 Collaborate with technical teams and stakeholders to ensure web solutions meet functional, design, accessibility, and security expectations.

 Contribute to continuous improvements in website usability, performance, consistency, and overall user experience.


 Requirements


 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Web Development, or a related discipline.

 At least 3 years of professional web development experience.

 Recent, hands-on experience developing websites using Salesforce Experience Cloud within the last 12 months.

 Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Lightning Web Components.

 Demonstrated experience building and maintaining websites that comply with Section 508 and WCAG accessibility standards.

 Practical UI and UX design experience, including the creation of wireframes, mockups, and prototypes using Figma or comparable design tools.

 An active Salesforce Trailblazer account with a publicly accessible profile. Candidates must provide their Trailblazer profile URL.

 U.S. citizenship is mandatory.

 Ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Tier 1 federal background investigation (National Agency Check with Inquiries or equivalent). A security clearance is not required.

 Ability to properly handle and safeguard Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI).


 Required Salesforce Certification:

 Candidates must hold at least one current and verifiable certification from the following list:


 Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I (formerly Platform Developer I).

 Salesforce Certified Experience Cloud Consultant.

 Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator.

 Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder.


 All certifications must be listed on the candidate's resume, along with their Trailblazer profile URL. Credentials will be verified before interviews are scheduled.

 Preferred Qualifications:


 An additional current Salesforce certification beyond the required credential.

 Experience delivering a complete website redesign for a large public-facing organization.

 A professional portfolio showcasing previous web development and UI/UX design projects.

 Experience with web analytics tools, website performance monitoring, and search engine optimization (SEO).

 Previous experience supporting federal government technology programs.

 An existing favorable Tier 1 or higher federal background investigation.


 Remote Work and Location Requirements:


 This is a fully remote position.

 Candidates must currently reside in, or be willing to relocate to, one of the following states or supported locations: Alabama, Colorado, District of Columbia, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Louisiana, Maryland, Minnesota, Mississippi, North Carolina, New Jersey, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, or Virginia.

 Relocation assistance is not provided.


 Benefits


 Annual salary: $104,000–$124,000, depending on qualifications and experience.

 Fully remote work arrangement.

 Medical, dental, and vision insurance through a national provider network, with the employer covering most monthly premiums.

 Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA).

 Company-paid life insurance and disability coverage, including short-term, long-term, and accidental coverage.

 Supplemental insurance options.

 Paid time off (PTO).

 11 paid company holidays.

 401(k) retirement plan.

 Professional development reimbursement program covering undergraduate and graduate education, professional training, and industry certifications.

 Monthly reimbursements for transportation, parking, and mobile phone services.

 Opportunities to work with modern cloud technologies and contribute to meaningful federal digital transformation projects.

 A collaborative workplace that values innovation, employee contributions, professional growth, and customer success.

 Equal employment opportunities, including for veterans and individuals with disabilities.
